WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
sales_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date,
           f.gross_amount, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM business_date) AS year,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM business_date) AS month,
    SUM(gross_amount) AS sales_incl_vat,
    SUM(net_amount) AS sales_excl_vat,
    COUNT(*) AS line_count
FROM sales_lines
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM business_date) = 2024 
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM business_date) IN (8, 9)
GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM business_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM business_date)
ORDER BY year, month

SELECT MIN(sale_date) AS min_sale_date, MAX(sale_date) AS max_sale_date
FROM fact_sales_line

SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM business_date) AS year,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM business_date) AS month,
    SUM(net_sales_before_returns) AS net_sales_before_returns_from_control
FROM (
    SELECT business_date, net_sales + returns_net AS net_sales_before_returns
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM business_date) = 2024
      AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM business_date) IN (8, 9)
) control
GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM business_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM business_date)
ORDER BY year, month
